# Scott's Auto & Clutch Repair — slcautoshop.com

## About
Scott's Auto & Clutch Repair is a family-owned, independent auto repair shop in South Salt Lake, Utah (Salt Lake Valley). Founded in 1990 by Scott. We specialize in clutch replacement and manual transmission repair, and also perform brakes, exhaust, CV axles, suspension, diagnostics, and general auto repair.

## Contact
- Address: 144 W Crystal Ave, Salt Lake City, UT 84117
- Phone: (801) 485-4089
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8 AM–5:30 PM, Saturday by appointment, Sunday closed
- Website: https://slcautoshop.com

## Services
- Clutch Replacement & Repair
- Manual Transmission Repair
- Brake Service (pads, rotors, calipers, lines)
- Exhaust & Muffler Repair
- CV Axle & Driveshaft Repair
- Suspension & Steering
- Cooling System (radiator, water pump, hoses)
- Engine Diagnostics & Check Engine Light
- Complete Auto Repair

## Vehicle Brands Serviced
Toyota, Honda, Ford, Chevrolet, Nissan, Subaru, BMW, Mazda, Hyundai, Kia, Jeep, Dodge, and most other makes and models.

## Service Area
South Salt Lake, Salt Lake City, Sugar House, Millcreek, Murray, Taylorsville, West Valley City, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Sandy, Draper, and surrounding Salt Lake Valley communities.

## Policies
- No job is identical — repair scope varies by vehicle condition, year, and mileage
- Honest, transparent estimates before work begins
- Family-owned and operated since 1990
